definition: Three outcome-independent uniform subsets without replacement of1091 from1188 strict2025 games. Full-season masks determined by game IDs and RNG only; each calendar training sample intersects its fixed mask. Re-estimate B1 factors, old cards, and joint role ability with frozen methods; preserve all originally strict heldout stints as the common test sample. Offline model/card aggregation only; no simulation and no league calibration rerun. Same cutoff tracking reused (individual tracking and body/identity metadata do not become missing). Does not imitate non-random reasons why2024 games failed audit.
